axes_source: Read from data/brands/webflow.json: warmth from the hue and chroma of the primary #080808 and the canvas #FFFFFF; contrast from the ink #080808 on that canvas, its depth and the chroma of #080808; density from its 4px spacing base; geometry from its radii 0, 2, 4, 8px; formality from the chroma of its primary and ink; motion at 0.5 since its motion signature states no duration; type personality at 0.5 since neither face is in the engine's catalog.
brand_rule: The primary #080808 reaches 20.03:1 on the canvas #FFFFFF, at least the 3:1 a control needs, so it carries the action.
name: Webflow
